prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1128; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you were involved in. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sorry, can you repeat the question? Yes, my name is the claimant, and I was driving the blue sedan.

Q: Thank you. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was in the parking lot of a grocery store in Baytown, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space in the third row, heading toward the main exit.

Q: What happened as you were pulling out?

A: I checked my mirrors and started backing slowly. Then I felt a hard bump on the rear passenger side. The other vehicle was coming down the aisle, and I think they didn't see me until we made contact.

Q: Were you moving at the time of impact?

A: Only slowly, maybe a couple of miles an hour. But the jolt was enough to throw my head back and then forward into the steering wheel.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They diagnosed me with whiplash. My neck is stiff, and I've had headaches and pain radiating into my shoulders.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I'm seeing a physical therapist twice a week, and my doctor has me on muscle relaxants. Some days are better than others, but I can't turn my head fully to the left.

Q: Have you missed any time from work because of your injuries?

A: A few shifts, yes. I'm trying to keep working, but lifting and driving for long periods is hard right now.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
